description: Response members the spec gets wrong against the wire (live, 2026-11-18, v23.0, test number on a test WABA). GET /{WABA-ID}/phone_numbers returned a phone number with `verified_name`, `code_verification_status`, `display_phone_number`, `quality_rating`, `platform_type`, `throughput` and `id`, and no `status`. GET /{Phone-Number-ID}/settings returned `calling: { status: "NOT_SET", call_icon_visibility, callback_permission_status, call_permission_mode }` with no `ip_addresses` while calling is not enabled. Both lose `smithy.api#required`. GET /{Media-ID} for an uploaded 179-byte PNG returned `"file_size": 179`, a number where the spec has a string, so `file_size` becomes a Long. GET /{Phone-Number-ID}/whatsapp_business_profile returned `{ data: [{ about, description, vertical, websites, messaging_product }] }`: each item is the profile itself, not `{ business_profile: {...} }`, so the list holds WhatsAppBusinessProfile. GET /{Phone-Number-ID} with `fields=...,platform_type,throughput` returned `platform_type: "CLOUD_API"` and `throughput: { level: "STANDARD" }`, which PhoneNumberInfo gains.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Where the number is hosted, e.g. `CLOUD_API`.
